title: Entities based on the Moon airdropping tech to Earth

tellings.quote: So, so in what in your mind, what have they been doing? They've been airdropping tech here and there and

plain: Beings living on the Moon may have been dropping technology onto Earth "here and there" over time. Michels raises the idea as a question to his guest Randall Carlson, in an episode titled "The Moon Is An Alien Spaceship." He asks what such beings have been doing and suggests this as his own guess.
